purpose: 회의실 문맥 공급 비용 검증. 지능 성장 또는 모든 모델의 품질 유지에 대한 증명으로 사용하지 않는다.

methodology.source: 사용자 회의실을 읽기 전용으로 복제한 격리 SQLite와 동일한 원본 페르소나. 합성된 과거 포트 결정, 교정, 무관 발언 100개를 추가했다.
methodology.prompt: 승인된 배포 포트는 무엇인가? 숫자만 답해라.
methodology.measurement: 실제로 전송한 요청의 HTTP 상태, 모델 경로, SSE usage를 프록시에서 확인했다. 토큰 합계는 제공자 실측이며 구성요소별 수치는 추정치다.

productionSelectionPolicy.conversation: Rust BM25 + token-cost selection. Current owner input, full persona, common owner instructions, current speaker state and relevant corrections have priority. Raw transcripts remain in SQLite.
productionSelectionPolicy.tools: Conversation retains access through a compact registry presentation. Explicit resource/action tasks retain original native schemas. A known tool choice can load its native schema on the next ordinary tool round without a discovery-model call.
productionSelectionPolicy.workContextGuard: When native tool schemas and fixed identity exhaust the conversational target, use the established work-context policy so applicable procedures and evidence are retained. This change does not claim a cost improvement for that work path.
productionSelectionPolicy.budget: contextBudgetTokens defaults to a soft 2000-token estimate. Mandatory context can exceed it and the snapshot records requiredOverBudget. No persona or current owner message is truncated to satisfy this number.

incompleteOrRejectedExperiments.reason: FreeLLMAPI returned HTTP 429 after two completed baseline replies. No full-room improvement claim.

incompleteOrRejectedExperiments.scenario: compact registry forced onto a concrete file-read task
incompleteOrRejectedExperiments.reason: Extra workspace-list/read rounds and provider limits occurred. Pacing a request beyond 60 seconds also triggered the existing slow-model guard. Incomplete work trials are excluded from success and savings claims.
Earlier registry format; treatment hit its 512-output-token limit. Not counted as a quality-preservation result for the shipped policy.

regressionChecks: 9 participants still speak and see peer contributions
persona and common instructions remain verbatim
repeated rounds keep latest participant state without growing mandatory history indefinitely
compact dispatch still reaches real read/write operations through write approval
native work uses the established context policy when the conversation budget is insufficient
limits: Only one fully controlled live recall pair; no broad quality or cross-model performance proof.
The full original nine-agent API comparison remains incomplete.
The long original persona keeps measured input above the 2000-token target.
Per-component tokenizer figures are explicitly estimates; provider usage is retained separately.
